newsitem.title: FRANCE: Havas up on CEP bid talk.
newsitem.headline: Havas up on CEP bid talk.

text.p: Shares in media group Havas were higher after reports that it would bid today for the rest of communications company CEP.
Havas was expected to announce its bid for minorities in its CEP Communication unit later today which could cost between 2.5 and 3.0 billion francs Les Echos and La Tribune newspapers said.
The statement was expected after Bourse closing on Thursday.
CEP was suspended on Tuesday at 400 francs, pending a statement, and the market immediately speculated that 74-percent owner Havas would make a bid.
Havas declined to comment on the rumours.
Industry sources told Reuters that the boards of Havas and CEP were meeting today to discuss the bid.
Havas shares were up 0.9 percent at 392.50 francs.
